Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001069": As of 2026-03-31, Diego has the Ember team's pager this cycle, taking over from Oskar.  (about: Diego, Oskar, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001066": On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and flagged it because the service is not theirs.  (about: feature-flags service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1001054" [constraint]: As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1001050" [preference]: As of 2026-03-12, for anything Boreal-related, page Lena.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1001007": As of 2026-03-03, storage for the resizer's original uploads doubled in six months.  (about: resizer)
- memory_id "1001004" [decision]: As of 2026-03-03, Team Dune decided the resizer will keep original uploads for only 90 days.  (about: Team Dune, resizer)
- memory_id "1000996": As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service belongs to Team Cinder, which took it over from Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Cinder, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000948" [decision]: On 2026-01-22, the team decided the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because the duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.  (about: webhooks service, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000942": INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17.  (about: webhooks service, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000883": As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000876" [decision]: On 2025-12-17, Team Dune decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000823": As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal, which took it over from Team Cinder.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Cinder, event bus)
- memory_id "1000821": As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed.  (about: event bus)
- memory_id "1000731": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk, leaving stale results for two days.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000683" [decision]: As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly and no longer depends on the ledger.  (about: ledger, event bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000642": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000518": On 2025-07-03, Team Cinder noticed the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent following the traffic shift and flagged it, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Cinder, event bus)
- memory_id "1000511": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas flagged that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the notifier is not their service.  (about: Team Atlas, notifier)
- memory_id "1000485": On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, noting the event bus is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000447": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal owns the catalog service, having taken it over from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000445": As of 2025-06-16, dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000371": On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal flagged that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the catalog service is not their service.  (about: Team Boreal, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000341": Team Atlas flagged on 2025-04-18 that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000327": The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down.  (about: catalog service, resizer)
- memory_id "1000307": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000305" [decision]: As of 2025-04-04, the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000201": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
Existing entity names: Diego, Oskar, Ember team, feature-flags service, catalog service, Team Boreal, Lena, resizer, Team Dune, Team Cinder, webhooks service, INC-2026-003, Team Atlas, auth gateway, indexer, event bus, INC-2025-023, reindex job, ledger, reporting service, notifier
